description: Asks how the #...# date-literal parser reads spellings that c-date-text-and-literals does not use: an out-of-range hour, impossible days and a leap day, time-only forms with AM/PM and 24:00, month-name and day-name forms, two-digit and four-digit years around the century window and below year 100, the first and last representable moments and one past each, spaces inside the delimiters, a T separator, fractional seconds, an empty, one-part and non-date body, and arithmetic on a literal. Each literal is its own snapshot SELECT expr, VarType(expr), CDbl(expr) FROM One; results depend on the locale, which the run records. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
